amendments.reason: Human-intelligence evidence audit + routed first/second point hypotheses before Phase1 research. Existing 28-day rule and promotion thresholds unchanged. Limit calibration to prediagnostic data; do not use the Phase1A optional 2020–2024 calibrator to tune on burned diagnostics.

comparators: literal incumbent replica secondary labeled chronology-unsafe

eligibility.format: ordinary tour BO3 tiebreak singles, known historical Slam rules; team events, Olympics, NextGen, Laver, unknown G event block
eligibility.history: both players >=5 legal decided matches; RAW excludes W/O/unplayed. No serve-availability exclusion at match level
eligibility.identity: tour-scoped source IDs only; no name inference/crosswalk merging
eligibility.point_population: CLEAN with logically valid both-player components only; report separate coverage

families.C: surface serve/return; vs S and I; separate mandatory human evidence benchmark parent
families.D: first/second channel interaction on surface; vs C only if C earns component gate
families.HUMAN: C + fixed old opponent-adjusted trajectory; frozen benchmark, not complete current human analyst
families.I: overall serve/return explicit interaction; vs U
families.R: old residual trajectory correction; vs C only if C earns component gate
families.S: surface serve, no receiver; vs U
families.STACK: one symmetric ridge-logit stack [mechanics,C Elo,rank]; only if a mechanics component survives, fit 2016–2019 only

hyperparameters.rank: single no-intercept log rank-points ratio Newton MLE on DEV2016–2019
hyperparameters.stack: no intercept; L2 50 toward [1,0,0], max100 Newton; logit predictors, no grid

match_gate.bootstrap_unit: tour|season|tournament_id; resample entire clusters and recompute match-weighted paired means

oracles: POSTGAME_ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: actual point rates through scoring and actual hold vs predicted hold; never fitting/selection
outputs: receipts with feature counts dates hashes component contributions uncertainty
sealed_confirmation_in_this_driver: FORBIDDEN; stop before opening 2025; separate certified frozen confirmation driver required
selection: Component gates before combination; candidate lowest selection Brier among gate-approved models; require full match gate vs strongest predeclared fair baseline. Preserve all rejected families. Freeze lock before diagnostics. Diagnostics cannot revise selection.
